title: All Core Devs - Consensus (ACDC) #181, June 25 2026
agendaMarkdown:
Devnet updates:
- Glamsterdam Devnet-5: What's the current status and are client teams getting support? 
- Devnet-6 readiness status?
- Test slashing validators pre-fork — Nico Flaig raised on ACDT #84: we should test EIP-8045 (exclude slashed validators) properly before mainnet. Is this planned?
- Spec bug? [https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/issues/5399]

Other topics:
- Builder API — remove `submitBeaconBlock` (builder-specs#162). Revisit now that devnet-6 is about to launch with builder integration. (bharath-123)
- Builder API — circuit breakers — `@bharath-123`: should we specify clients MUST fallback to self-build with impl-dependent heuristics (like Bellatrix)? Standardize or leave flexible?
- FYI Staked Builder API (builder-specs#138) has been merged. 
- Proposer Preferences API — remaining concerns on beacon-APIs#608? (james-prysm)
- Has anyone reviewed this? Beacon API #618 validator state renaming — breaking change; `pending-queued` states outdated post-EIP-6110/7251. Ecosystem tooling impact assessed? (leobago, barnabasbusa)
-  (feat: extend /eth/v1/node/peers with peer scoring and disconnect reasons)[Beacon API #606] — requested by `@barnabasbusa`. Status?


Glamsterdam:
- EIP-8080 DFI — let exits use consolidation queue. Intent to DFI stated in PQ Interop #15. Any remaining blockers?
- EIP-8045 SFI — exclude slashed validators from proposing. Was CFI→SFI in #179. Potuz to open Prysm PR — status? Can we SFI now?
- EIP-8282 — builder execution requests. `@nflaig` requested discussion at #180. DoS attack surface vs. impl cost tradeoff assessed? Builder deposit limit risk revisited?

Hegota:

- Hegota non-headliner window — opened after EL headliner decision. End date still TBD based on Glamsterdam progress.
